这篇文章是给准备搬入新房、或者即将搬出当前住处的租客看的。很多押金和交接问题，不: This article is for tenants moving into a new home or out of their current one. Many deposit and handover problems don't start with a major incident; they start with missing photos, missing records, or unclear handover arrangements.
搬入第一天先别急着收拾: Don't rush to unpack on move-in day
刚拿到钥匙时最重要的事不是摆家具，而是先把房屋现状记录下来。墙面、地板、窗户、浴: When you get the keys, record the home's condition before arranging furniture. Walls, floors, windows, bathrooms, the kitchen, appliances, locks, remotes, and parking spaces are all worth documenting if they could affect the deposit or responsibilities later.
拍整屋照片和视频，尽量带上时间顺序，别只拍局部。: Photograph and film the entire home in a clear time sequence, not just isolated areas.
把现有划痕、污渍、松动、缺件和不能正常使用的地方单独记录。: Record existing scratches, stains, loose fittings, missing parts, and anything that doesn't work properly separately.
钥匙、门禁、邮箱钥匙、车库遥控器数量要确认清楚。: Confirm the number of keys, access fobs, mailbox keys, and garage remotes.
把入住当天发现的问题尽快发给房东、物业或主租人留痕。: Promptly send any move-in-day issues to the landlord, property manager, or primary tenant so there is a record.
押金相关信息最好一开始就对清楚: Clarify deposit details from the start
很多人直到搬出前才去翻当时交了什么钱、怎么退，已经晚了。入住时就要确认哪些属于押: Waiting until move-out to find out what you paid and how it is returned is too late. At move-in, distinguish deposits, rent, and other fees, and confirm who handles repayment and by what method after you leave. Rules, deadlines, and allowable deductions can change; refer to the contract, official information, or professional advice.
住的过程中要把小问题养成记录习惯: Build a habit of documenting small problems while you live there
住进去之后，像漏水、墙皮脱落、电器异常、门锁卡住这类问题，最好不要拖到搬出时才说: Don't wait until move-out to mention leaks, peeling walls, appliance problems, or sticking locks. Reporting them early makes it easier to distinguish preexisting issues from problems that develop during your tenancy.
报修尽量留文字记录，不要只口头讲。: Keep written repair requests rather than relying only on verbal conversations.
如果是合租，公共区域的损耗和清洁最好平时就说清楚。: In a shared home, clarify responsibility for common-area wear and cleaning as part of everyday arrangements.
自己添置或更换过的东西，搬走前要确认是不是需要恢复原状。: Before leaving, confirm whether anything you added or replaced must be restored.
重要沟通尽量别散落在多个聊天窗口里。: Try not to scatter important conversations across multiple chat windows.
搬出前别只想着打包: Before moving out, think beyond packing
真正影响交接顺不顺的，是你搬出前一周到最后一天做了什么。清洁、修补、拍照、钥匙归: What you do from the week before moving out through the final day has a real effect on the handover. Cleaning, small repairs, photos, key returns, and the final walkthrough matter more than you might expect. In shared housing, also agree who handles common areas and who ends utility and internet service.
把自己的物品和垃圾彻底清空，不要留下“之后再回来拿”的模糊状态。: Remove all your belongings and trash. Don't leave an unclear “I'll come back for it” arrangement.
基础清洁至少要做到厨房、浴室、地面、冰箱和垃圾处理清楚。: At minimum, basic cleaning should cover the kitchen, bathroom, floors, refrigerator, and trash.
搬出当天再拍一轮全屋照片和视频，尤其是原来有争议的位置。: Take another complete set of photos and videos on move-out day, especially of any previously disputed areas.
把钥匙、门禁、停车证、包裹柜权限等交接方式提前说好。: Agree beforehand on returning keys, access fobs, parking permits, and parcel-locker access.
保留 forwarding address 和最后的转账、交接记录。: Keep your forwarding address and final payment and handover records.
合租搬出时最容易卡住的地方: Common sticking points when moving out of a shared home
如果你不是整套房一起搬走，而是中途退出合租，最容易出问题的是押金怎么结、房间由谁: If you're leaving a shared home while others stay, the biggest issues are often settling the deposit, finding someone to take the room, and dividing shared belongings. Don't assume the primary tenant will automatically manage it all or that the next roommate will seamlessly take over.
照片不是为了吵架，是为了省事: Photos are there to save hassle, not start an argument
很多人觉得拍太多像不信任别人，其实完整记录往往能减少来回解释。搬入和搬出各留一套: Taking many photos may feel distrustful, but complete records often reduce explanations later. A clear set at move-in and another at move-out are more effective than trying to remember afterward how things used to look.
